prompt.project_info: An idyllic, serene cottagecore summer picnic portrait that connects the subject with nature.
prompt.main_subject: Young adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair with caramel highlights, center-parted and cascading down her back, warm tan skin, a gentle inviting smile, and fresh natural makeup with rosy cheeks and soft lipstick. She wears the specified white mini dress with puff sleeves, square neckline, open back with crisscross tie detailing, and ruched fabric, plus white socks.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium shot from a slightly high angle: she sits on a white picnic sheet in a grassy meadow under a large shade tree, knees bent comfortably and torso turned slightly forward. She gently holds a bouquet of daisies, yellow buttercups, and purple clover in front of her chest. Include textured tree bark, lush foliage, glimpses of blue sky, tall summer grass, and a woven wicker picnic basket at left.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright but soft natural daylight filtered through leaves. Dappled sunlight creates dynamic soft shadows on the arm and dress, with contrast between sunlit areas and shade; retain a cheerful, relaxed, romantic summery atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm or 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8, medium framing, shallow depth of field and bokeh on background leaves, sharp focus on face and flower bouquet, ultra-photorealistic detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Young adult woman with long, wavy, dark brown hair with caramel highlights, center-parted and cascading loosely down the back, warm tan skin, gentle inviting smile, looking directly at the camera, fresh natural makeup, rosy cheeks, soft lipstick. White mini dress with puff sleeves, square neckline, open back with crisscross tie detailing, ruched fabric, white socks, cottagecore romantic summer-chic style. Seated on the ground in a grassy meadow under a large shade tree, side profile to camera with torso turned slightly forward, knees bent on a white picnic sheet, gently holding a bouquet of daisies, yellow buttercups, and purple clover in front of her chest. Textured tree trunk, lush green foliage, blue-sky patches, tall summer grass, woven wicker picnic basket at left. Bright but soft natural daylight and dappled sunlight filtered through leaves, dynamic soft shadows, idyllic serene cheerful romantic summery picnic mood. Medium shot, slightly high angle, 50mm or 85mm portrait lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on face and bouquet, ultra-photorealistic.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. If person, wardrobe, flower, or location references are attached, preserve the specified white cottagecore dress, bouquet, seated picnic pose, tree-shade meadow, wicker basket, and dappled summer light. Individual appearance, dress color, and field details may be replaced while retaining the composition.
